parameters.name: AssetsIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the affected asset.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Specifies the page number to return in a paged query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: Specifies the end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used.

parameters.name: EventKey
parameters.description: The ID of the compromise awareness event.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: The name of the compromise awareness event.

parameters.name: EventUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the compromise awareness event.

parameters.name: IsIgnore
parameters.description: Specifies whether the compromise awareness event is ignored. Valid values:

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type of the received message. Valid values:

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member accounts.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the number of entries per page in a paged query.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the requester.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Specifies the start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the query starts from the last 30 days.
